Hint: an old tutorial said "Optionally, to view contributors during a specific time period, to the right of "Contributors," click Period: All.", but those labels may have moved or been renamed.
When the goal is met, verify it on screen. If the page you end on has a main heading, store it as 'landed_on'; a page without a heading is fine.
